record.paper_title: Absolute continuity, Lyapunov exponents and rigidity I : geodesic flows
record.original_question: For a fixed differentiability class C^r with r >= 1, is accessibility C^r-dense among partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms whose center bundle has dimension greater than one? Here a partially hyperbolic diffeomorphism is accessible when any two points in the ambient manifold can be joined by an su-path, meaning a piecewise smooth path whose every leg lies in a single stable leaf W^s or a single unstable leaf W^u. The question asks for the higher-center-dimensional case of the Pugh-Shub accessibility-density conjecture, after the one-dimensional center case has been settled in the cited results.

evidence.quote: It remains open whether C r -density still holds when dim Ec > 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a closed smooth Riemannian manifold and $r\ge 1$ an integer. A diffeomorphism $f\in\mathrm{Diff}^r(M)$ is called partially hyperbolic if there exist a continuous $Df$-invariant splitting $TM=E^s\oplus E^c\oplus E^u$ and constants $0<\lambda<\mu<1$ (with $\lambda\mu^{-1}<1$) such that for some Riemannian metric and all unit vectors $v^s\in E^s$, $v^c\in E^c$, $v^u\in E^u$:
\[\|Df\,v^s\|<\lambda<\|Df\,v^c\|<\mu^{-1}<\|Df\,v^u\|\quad\text{(after appropriate normalization).}\]
It is classical that $E^s$ and $E^u$ are uniquely integrable, tangent to $f$-invariant foliations $\mathcal{W}^s$ and $\mathcal{W}^u$ (the strong stable and unstable foliations).

An $su$-path in $M$ is a piecewise smooth path $\gamma:[0,1]\to M$ that decomposes into finitely many legs, each of which is contained in a single leaf of $\mathcal{W}^s$ or a single leaf of $\mathcal{W}^u$. The diffeomorphism $f$ is called accessible if any two points of $M$ can be joined by an $su$-path.

Question: For every integer $r\ge 1$, is the set of accessible diffeomorphisms $C^r$-dense in the space of $C^r$ partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms of $M$ for which the center bundle $E^c$ has dimension strictly greater than one?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is established when $\dim E^c = 1$ ($C^r$-density for all $r\ge 1$, Burns–Hertz–Hertz–Talitskaya–Ures and Rodriguez Hertz–Rodriguez Hertz–Ures). For higher-dimensional center, $C^1$-density of accessibility is known (Dolgopyat–Wilkinson; Avila–Crovisier–Wilkinson), and $C^r$-density has been obtained for 2D center under additional hypotheses (strong bunching, stable dynamical coherence). The general $C^r$-density problem for $\dim E^c > 1$ remains open.

status_evidence.title: Accessibility for dynamically coherent partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms with 2D center
status_evidence.snippet: Stable accessibility is C^r-dense among partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms with two-dimensional center that satisfy strong bunching and are stably dynamically coherent.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress: C^r-density for 2D center under additional hypotheses.

status_evidence.title: Density of accessibility for partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms with one-dimensional center
status_evidence.snippet: Stable accessibility is C^r-dense among partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms with one-dimensional center bundle, for r ≥ 2.

status_evidence.title: Partial hyperbolicity - Scholarpedia
status_evidence.snippet: Accessibility holds for the C^1 case of the conjecture without restrictions on the dimension of the center bundle.
status_evidence.claim: C^1-density known in all center dimensions; higher C^r case remains open in general.
